Running it
----------
simcity.d88 is a disk image for a Sharp MZ-800 (or MZ-1500) with a disk
unit (the MZ-1E05 or an MB8876 interface): a 3.5 inch 2DD disk, 2 sides,
80 cylinders, 16 sectors of 256 bytes.  Put it in the first drive and reset
the machine in MZ-800 mode (not MZ-700 mode): the IPL boots it, printing
the game's name while it loads, and with no BASIC or other disk needed.

The game uses the 320 x 200 screen in four colours (green, yellow, blue and
red, chosen from the sixteen by the palette) as a grid of 40 by 25 cells,
and the SN76489 for the sound effects.  The map is 96 x 96 squares and
there are no scenarios.

Cities are saved to and loaded from the same disk, in one of six slots
after the game itself (so the disk must not be write protected, and the
image file is changed when you save).  The game lists the saved cities when
you load or save, so you pick one; a new name takes a free slot, and an old
one is replaced.

This has been run in Takeda's EmuZ-800, and its disk driver and the game
under a model of the machine (with the real IPL ROM).  A real MZ-800 is
untested.

Keys
----
  Cursor keys     move the cursor one square (shifted: eight)
  Q A O P         up, down, left, right (shifted: eight squares)
  Space           build with the tool
  , .             the previous and next tool
  0 - 9           choose a tool by its number
  H               pause or run
  + -             faster, slower
  M               the next mini map (X goes back to the city)
  B               the budget            V   the evaluation
  S               save the city         L   load a city
  X               the game menu: new city, options, disasters
  BREAK           the same menu (and Esc in the dialogues)
